d:
Watch Malargal Kaettaen from O Kadhal Kanmani in Chitra & A.R. Rahman’s voice. Written by Vairamuthu, the song is a beautiful unfolding of a lover’s request to finally attain her beloved.
Song Name - Malargal Kaettaen
Movie - O Kadhal Kanmani
Singer - Chitra & A.R. Rahman
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Vairamuthu
Director - Mani Ratnam
Starring - Dulquer Salmaan, Nithya Menen
